theater: 埃及亞歷山大與尼羅河三角洲

battle.name: 英土戰爭 (1807年-1809年)
battle.theater: 埃及亞歷山大與尼羅河三角洲
battle.brief: 英土戰爭（1807 至 1809）自英軍在埃及登陸起，以 1809 年《達達尼爾斯條約》告終。英軍在亞歷山大擊退穆罕默德・阿里率領的奧斯曼・埃及軍，再於布拉格以衝鋒龍騎撞散馬穆魯克騎兵。卡面這件長槍源於西班牙大方陣，此時僅存於英軍高地團第三排的守方長矛與馬穆魯克騎兵的長騎槍。

kit.name: 長槍
kit.history: 方陣的長矛讓火槍隊站在後面。密西西比之後，長矛和火槍一起站住了。

countries: 交戰一方是大不列顛王國的皇家海軍與英國陸軍，指揮系統分兩層：倫敦海軍部決定政策與艦隊調配，地中海方面的實際作戰由分艦隊司令主持，1807 年五月強行通過達達尼爾斯的是達克沃思爵士，1808 年三月率主力艦解亞歷山大之圍的是科頓少將。陸軍方面，1807 年三月登陸埃及的是赫利・哈欽森中將率領的遠征軍，1808 年初率援軍接防的是穆雷爵士，部隊以英格蘭與蘇格蘭常備步兵為主，另有海軍陸戰隊、海軍步兵與水兵組成的海軍支隊承擔登岸先鋒與隨軍火力。交戰另一方是奧斯曼帝國：海軍歸凱普丹帕夏統率，陸軍由大維齊爾與軍隊總督節制，1807 至 1808 年在埃及的實際指揮落在穆罕默德・阿里帕夏手上，其部隊由禁衛步兵、魯梅利亞省軍、阿爾巴尼亞與魯美利亞的散兵，以及鄂圖曼與埃及混編的騎兵構成。第三方因素同樣關鍵：法國自 1806 年底與奧斯曼簽訂同盟條約，在敘利亞派駐使節，並向埃及派遣法籍工程師與炮兵顧問；俄羅斯自 1806 年起對奧斯曼開戰，1807 年與英國結盟，奧斯曼被迫在多瑙河與東地中海兩面分兵；阿拉伯半島內志的聯盟勢力與奧斯曼在漢志長期對抗，英國則利用紅海航線向其提供干擾以牽制奧斯曼分兵。
countriesEn: One belligerent was the Royal Navy and the army of Great Britain, and its command system had two layers: the Admiralty in London set policy and moved squadrons, while the fighting in the Mediterranean was run by the commander of the detached squadron. Sir John Duckworth forced the Dardanelles in May 1807, and Rear-Admiral Charles Cotton brought the line of battle to lift the siege of Alexandria in March 1808. On the land side, the expedition that landed in Egypt in March 1807 was commanded by Lieutenant-General Sir John Hely Hutchinson, and the relief force that took over in the following year was led by Sir George Murray. The troops were chiefly English and Scottish line infantry, with a naval detachment of Royal Marines, naval infantry and seamen serving as the assault troops and as the campaign's mobile gun support. The other belligerent was the Ottoman Empire: its fleet answered to the Kapudan Pasha, its army to the Grand Vizier and the serasker, and in Egypt between 1807 and 1808 the real command lay with Muhammad Ali Pasha, whose force combined Janissary infantry, Rumelian provincial troops, Albanian and Rumelian irregulars, and a mixed Ottoman-Egyptian cavalry. Third parties mattered just as much. France concluded an alliance treaty with the Ottoman Empire at the end of 1806, kept an envoy in Syria, and sent French engineers and artillery advisers to Egypt. Russia had been at war with the Ottomans since 1806 and allied with Britain in 1807, forcing the Ottomans to divide their strength between the Danube and the eastern Mediterranean. In Arabia, the tribal confederation of the interior was already fighting the Ottomans in the Hejaz, and Britain was willing to stir that front from the Red Sea to pull Ottoman troops away from Egypt.
people: 關鍵人物集中在兩個戰場。奧斯曼・埃及一方是穆罕默德・阿里帕夏，他自 1805 年起任埃及總督，1807 年三月下令解除開羅的馬穆魯克武裝並加以清剿，此舉消滅了埃及最後一支獨立的重騎兵，也使他成為任何駐紮尼羅河的英軍必然要面對的敵手；1808 年二月他率奧斯曼・埃及軍圍攻亞歷山大，三月二十一日在城外被英軍擊退，五月十六日布拉格之戰中大腿中彈，其子易卜拉欣帕夏率殘部北撤，英軍於五月二十日進入開羅。英方關鍵人物包括 1807 年遠征的統帥赫利・哈欽森中將，正是他在埃及的經驗令英國在拿破崙重啟歐洲戰事後仍保留一支小部隊在尼羅河谷；接任的穆雷爵士於 1808 年春率援軍自羅塞塔方向北上解圍，科頓少將的主力艦群則在近海接應，轉運整支陸軍與補給。海上，達克沃思爵士 1807 年五月強行通過達達尼爾斯的失敗，令英國把重心由海峽轉向埃及與愛琴海。幕後還有兩人：法國駐敘利亞使節在黎凡特遊說勢力抵抗英軍在埃及的推進；法籍炮兵顧問塞夫則替埃及軍改良砲兵，日後以蘇萊曼帕夏之名把這套技術帶出埃及。倫敦方面，閣臣在 1807 年夏天拿破崙重開歐洲戰事後，對是否長期投入兵力一直猶豫。
peopleEn: The decisive personalities divide cleanly between the two camps. On the Ottoman-Egyptian side stands Muhammad Ali Pasha, governor of Egypt from 1805, who in March 1807 ordered the disarmament and massacre of the Mamluk households in Cairo; that act destroyed the last independent heavy cavalry of Egypt and made him the permanent enemy of any British force on the Nile. In February 1808 he besieged Alexandria with an Ottoman-Egyptian army, was beaten outside the walls on 21 March, and was wounded in the thigh at the battle of Boulak on 16 May, after which his son Ibrahim Pasha withdrew the survivors north and the British entered Cairo on 20 May. On the British side, Hutchinson, the commander of the 1807 expedition, was the man whose experience in Egypt argued for keeping a small force on the Nile even after Napoleon's declaration of war; his successor Murray marched north with reinforcements in the spring of 1808 and broke the siege, with Cotton's squadron of ships of the line standing offshore to receive and retransport the army and its supplies. Duckworth's failed forcing of the Dardanelles in May 1807 had redirected British attention from the straits to Egypt and the Aegean. Two figures worked in the background: the French envoy in Syria, who urged the Levantine powers to resist the British advance into Egypt, and the French artillery adviser Sève, who served the Egyptian besiegers and later, as Suleiman Pasha, carried Egyptian artillery practice far beyond the country. In London, ministers hesitated to commit more troops while Napoleon reopened the war in Europe in the summer of 1807.
kits: 卡面這件長槍是十六世紀西班牙大方陣的方陣矛，長約五至六公尺，木桿配鐵矛頭，矛尖後方有防護的鐵套，由披甲兵與長矛兵執握，用途是把騎兵擋在方陣之外，讓披掛火槍的射手在盾牆後安全射擊；十六世紀末以後，方陣矛在歐洲逐步被火槍加刺刀的綫列步兵取代，本役開打時它早已不是任何一國的主力兵器。取而代之的是火槍與刺刀：英軍步兵使用口徑零點五七七英吋的滑膛燧發火槍，配彎刀刺刀，軍官與鼓手仍執儀仗用的標槍與戟；英軍高地團則按 1768 年以來的英軍步兵條例，在每連由軍官率領的一排第三排保留四十二吋長矛，專職抵禦騎兵衝撞，高地營的操典中亦保留長矛與刺刀並用的合練。對面的長兵器是馬穆魯克騎兵手裡約三公尺的長騎槍，配彎刀與圓盾，1808 年布拉格之戰中密集列陣衝擊英軍龍騎，是本役最接近方陣矛功能的一件兵器。奧斯曼・埃及的步兵此時已是火槍配短矛與標槍，禁衛步兵在 1808 年亦大量改用火槍，成建制的長矛線已不復存在；法籍炮兵顧問塞夫為其改良的攻城砲與野戰砲在圍城與野戰中都相當出色。攻城與海運方面，英軍以艦隊輸送登陸，步兵身後只帶數門輕便野戰砲，另有海軍支隊的船載砲與水兵上岸作戰；奧斯曼・埃及軍靠尼羅河船隊運糧，由陸路向開羅與三角洲調兵，馬匹與駱駝在沙漠路段的補給效率遠低於英軍的海上運輸。
kitsEn: The pike on this card is the square pike of the sixteenth-century Spanish tercio: a shaft of five to six metres with an iron head and a reinforcing sleeve behind the point, carried by pikemen and men-at-arms whose task was to keep cavalry outside the square so that the arquebusiers and musketeers could fire safely from behind the shield wall. From the late sixteenth century the square pike was steadily displaced by line infantry carrying musket and bayonet, and by the time this war opened it was the main weapon of no country at all. What had replaced it was the musket and the bayonet: British infantry carried .577-calibre smoothbore flintlock muskets with socket bayonets, while officers and drummers still bore the spontoon and the halberd for dress. British Highland regiments, however, kept a survival of the old arm: following regulations in force since 1768, each company retained forty-two inch pikes in the third rank of the platoon led by its officer, purely to check cavalry, and Highland battalion drill still included combined pike and bayonet exercise. The long weapon on the other side was the lance, some three metres long, carried by the Mamluk horsemen together with scimitar and round shield; in the battle of Boulak in 1808 the Mamluk lancers charged the British dragoons in close order, and this was the weapon in this campaign that came closest to the function of the old pike. Ottoman-Egyptian infantry by 1808 carried muskets with short spears and javelins, and the Janissaries had largely taken up the musket as well, so that no formed line of pikes survived. The Egyptian artillery, improved by the French adviser Sève, performed conspicuously well in both siege and field. For siege work and supply, the British landed from the fleet, marched with only a handful of light field guns, and added ship-borne cannon and naval gun crews as they advanced; the Ottoman-Egyptian army moved its grain on the Nile and shifted troops to Cairo and the Delta overland, where horses and camels carried supplies far less efficiently than British sea transport.
tactics: 戰術可以分成登陸攻勢、攻城消耗與野戰決戰三段。1807 年三月英軍以海軍陸戰隊與海軍步兵為先導，在亞歷山大以西的海灘登陸，隨即以縱隊向內陸推進，奪城後轉向開羅，沿尼羅河谷大道晝夜行軍，六月進抵開羅並迫使守軍退往第一瀑布，八月抵達阿斯旺，因歐洲戰事重啟而於九月主動收縮。1808 年一月新一批部隊抵達，二月奧斯曼・埃及軍以重砲在城牆外挖出進攻城壕，英軍則倚靠城垣與古羅馬遺跡構成的核心地帶死守。三月二十一日援軍趕到，英軍以步兵線列與海軍支隊在城西正面迎敵：馬穆魯克騎兵在密集縱隊中反覆衝鋒，被方陣前的刺刀與火槍齊射擋回，待其隊形散亂，英軍龍騎與步兵方陣才發動反擊，把圍城部隊整體逼回三角洲。五月十六日布拉格之戰是典型的平原騎兵決戰：英軍先用砲火與前哨騎兵擾亂馬穆魯克陣地，再以輕龍騎密集衝鋒迎上對方的長騎槍，馬穆魯克騎兵在正面碰撞中崩潰，埃及步兵與散兵被衝散，英軍隨即長驅入城。戰後英軍沿尼羅河北上直抵第一瀑布，另分遣小股部隊經陸路與海路進向蘇伊士與紅海沿岸，並在漢志方向接觸反對奧斯曼的阿拉伯聯盟勢力；海軍同時封鎖埃及沿岸，1808 年七月五至六日在愛琴海斯科普洛斯外海與奧斯曼巡防艦交火。
tacticsEn: The campaign divides into three tactical phases: the amphibian advance, the siege attrition and the field action. In March 1807 the Royal Marines and naval infantry led the landing on the coast west of Alexandria, pushed inland in column, seized the city and turned on Cairo, marching day and night along the valley road, entering Cairo in June, driving the garrison to the First Cataract and reaching Aswan in August before contracting the expedition in September as the war in Europe reopened. A second body of troops arrived in January 1808; in February the Ottoman-Egyptian army opened approaches against the walls with heavy guns and saps, and the British held the old Roman ruins in the middle of the position as their anchor. On 21 March the relieving force arrived and the British met the besiegers in the open west of the city: Mamluk cavalry charged again and again in compact columns, were thrown back by the bayonets and the volley fire of the line, and as their formation loosened the British dragoons and infantry squares went forward and pressed the whole investing force back into the Delta. The battle of Boulak on 16 May was a plain cavalry action: British artillery and outposts disorder the Mamluk position, then the light dragoons charged home in a dense body straight into the opposing lances, the Mamluk horse broke under the shock, Egyptian infantry and irregulars were scattered, and the British rode into the city. The advance then ran north along the Nile to the First Cataract, with small detachments pushed by land and sea towards Suez and the Red Sea coast and towards the Hejaz, where British officers made contact with the Arabian confederation fighting the Ottomans; at sea the British blockaded the Egyptian coast and fought the Ottoman frigates off Skopelos in the Aegean on 5 and 6 July 1808.
data: 可核對的數字集中在幾個節點。時間線是：1807 年一月一日英國對奧斯曼宣戰，三月英軍在埃及登陸，九月遠征主動收縮；1808 年一月第二支遠征軍抵達，三月二十一日亞歷山大之戰，五月十六日布拉格之戰，五月二十日英軍進入開羅；1809 年一月五日《達達尼爾斯條約》訂立，其後英軍撤出埃及。兵力方面，亞歷山大之戰英軍一方約二千至二千三百人，其中海軍陸戰隊與水兵佔數百，配野戰砲數門，防守正面約一英里半；奧斯曼・埃及軍約一萬至一萬二千人，其中騎兵約三千至四千，並配相當數量的攻城砲與野戰砲；具體數字各書不一，誤差可達數千。布拉格之戰投入的英軍為數百名步兵與龍騎，而對方馬穆魯克騎兵數千。損失方面，英軍陣亡為數十人、傷者數百，奧斯曼・埃及軍陣亡與被俘者遠多於此，據英方報告有五千至六千名埃及軍放下武器，其餘向北潰散；1807 年三月開羅解除馬穆魯克武裝時，被殺者數目從數百到逾千不等，諸說並存。彈藥上，滑膛燧發槍每名步兵通常攜帶約六十發，戰時日耗常達六十至九十發，裝載量直接決定英軍在沙漠路段的推進速度；行軍速度一般每日二十至三十公里，由亞歷山大至開羅的行軍約在一個月內完成。
dataEn: The verifiable figures cluster around a few fixed points. The timeline runs: Britain declared war on the Ottoman Empire on 1 January 1807; British troops landed in Egypt in March and the expedition was deliberately contracted in September; a second expeditionary body arrived in January 1808; the battle of Alexandria was fought on 21 March; the battle of Boulak on 16 May; the British entered Cairo on 20 May; the Treaty of the Dardanelles was signed on 5 January 1809, after which the British withdrew from Egypt. On strength, the British at Alexandria numbered roughly two thousand to two thousand three hundred men, of whom several hundred were Royal Marines and seamen, with a few field guns, holding a front of about one and a half miles; the Ottoman-Egyptian army numbered on the order of ten thousand to twelve thousand, including three or four thousand cavalry and a substantial number of siege and field pieces. The sources differ, and the spread between them runs into the thousands. At Boulak the British committed a few hundred foot and dragoons against several thousand Mamluk horsemen. On losses, the British dead numbered in the tens and the wounded in the hundreds, while the Ottoman-Egyptian dead and prisoners were far heavier: by British accounts between five and six thousand Egyptian soldiers laid down their arms and the rest broke north. In March 1807, when the Mamluks of Cairo were disarmed, the number killed is given anywhere from several hundred to well over a thousand, and the figures remain disputed. On ammunition, a soldier with a smoothbore flintlock musket usually carried about sixty rounds and could expend between sixty and ninety in a day, so the size of the ammunition load directly set the pace of the advance through the desert stages; the marching rate was generally twenty to thirty kilometres a day, and the march from Alexandria to Cairo took roughly a month.
cause: 打起來的原因是英國認定奧斯曼已成為法國在東地中海的支點。1806 年底奧斯曼與法國簽訂同盟條約後，英國擔心法國以埃及與敘利亞為基地威脅通往印度的航路，也擔心法國技術在奧斯曼軍隊中擴散，戰事中確實有法籍工程師與炮兵顧問直接參與埃及的攻城與野戰。1806 年俄羅斯對奧斯曼開戰後，英國本想借俄軍在多瑙河的攻勢牽制君士坦丁堡；1807 年夏天拿破崙在蒂爾西特條約中把英國重新拖入歐洲，卻也讓英國看到一個可以不受牽制的短暫窗口：奧斯曼被迫在多瑙河與東地中海兩面作戰，兵力分散。於是英國把目標定在埃及，既是通往印度的最短陸路與紅海航線的咽喉，也是法國在東方影響最薄弱的一點。埃及總督穆罕默德・阿里在 1807 年三月對開羅馬穆魯克武裝的清剿，使英國判斷埃及已脫離奧斯曼中央控制、可以下手，卻也種下了整場戰爭最直接的軍事衝突：英軍必須在埃及建立一個能長期站穩的基地，而穆罕默德・阿里絕不會容忍英軍取代自己在埃及的權位。開戰後的形勢很快把這一點攤開：英軍要的是土地與航路，埃及人要的則是保住新得的權柄，兩者無法長期並存。
causeEn: The war came about because Britain judged that the Ottoman Empire had become the fulcrum of French power in the eastern Mediterranean. After the alliance treaty between France and the Porte at the end of 1806, London feared a French base in Egypt and Syria threatening the road to India, and feared French technical influence spreading through Ottoman troops; in the event, French engineers and artillery advisers did take a direct part in the siege and field work in Egypt. Russia had been at war with the Ottomans since 1806, and Britain had hoped to pull on the Porte through Russian pressure on the Danube. In the summer of 1807 Napoleon bound Britain back into the European war in the Treaty of Tilsit, but in doing so he also opened a short window in which Britain could act unencumbered, for the Ottomans were now forced to fight on two fronts, the Danube and the eastern Mediterranean, with their strength split. Britain therefore set its sights on Egypt, which was both the throat of the shortest overland route and the Red Sea approaches to India, and the point where French influence in the East was thinnest. Muhammad Ali's disarmament and massacre of the Mamluk households in Cairo in March 1807 convinced the British that Egypt had slipped from the control of the Ottoman centre and could be taken, but it also planted the seed of the war's most direct military collision: the British needed a base in Egypt they could hold, and Muhammad Ali would never accept that the British replace his authority in Egypt. Once the war began that tension came into the open, for the British wanted territory and sea lanes, and the Egyptians wanted to keep the power they had just seized; the two could not coexist for long.
impact: 影響主要落在埃及與英國的戰略版圖上。英軍在 1808 年佔領埃及後，穆罕默德・阿里退守尼羅河三角洲與亞歷山大之外的鄉間，隨即在英軍撤走之後重建自己的軍隊，逐步在埃及設立火槍廠、兵工廠與新式步兵團，並在往後二十多年裡把這支軍隊帶出埃及：1830 年代他率軍重返君士坦丁堡周邊，把奧斯曼帝國在巴爾幹與阿拉伯的體系撕開缺口，最終在克里米亞戰爭前後迫使歐洲列強重新評價東方的力量。埃及的馬穆魯克作為一支獨立重騎兵集團則在 1807、1810 與 1811 年被逐一拆解，舊式封建軍團的結構再無可能恢復。英國方面，這一戰確認了皇家海軍在東地中海沒有對手，也顯示皇家陸軍一旦離開海軍的補給線就難以在埃及長期維持：英國在 1809 年的和約中放棄埃及，1810 年因紅海與阿拉伯立足點再與奧斯曼開戰，最終在 1812 年前後退出紅海，把在阿拉伯半島的影響力押後到 1816 年的達曼條約。戰術上，這兩年把火槍加刺刀的綫列步兵方陣對上雜牌騎兵這一課反覆演示了一遍，長矛作為戰役兵器已經退場；同一條演進線上的高地營卻在 1815 年滑鐵盧與新奧爾良的密西西比河戰役中，把長矛與火槍一起留在防線上。
impactEn: The consequences fall mainly on Egypt and on the strategic map of British power. After the British occupied Egypt in 1808, Muhammad Ali fell back into the Delta and the country beyond Alexandria, and once the British withdrew he rebuilt his army, establishing arsenals, foundries and new infantry in Egypt, and within the following two decades carried that army out of the country: in the 1830s he led it back towards Constantinople, tearing open the Ottoman structure in the Balkans and Arabia, and by the time of the Crimean War he had forced the European powers to reassess the weight of eastern military power. The Mamluks of Egypt, as an independent body of heavy cavalry, were dismantled piecemeal in 1807, 1810 and 1811, and the old feudal military structure was never rebuilt. For Britain, the war confirmed that the Royal Navy had no rival in the eastern Mediterranean, and showed just as clearly that the Royal Army could not hold Egypt once it left the Navy's supply line: Britain gave Egypt up in the 1809 settlement, went to war with the Ottomans again in 1810 over its foothold in the Red Sea and Arabia, and withdrew from the Red Sea around 1812, deferring its influence in the peninsula until the Treaty of Daman in 1816. Tactically, the two years demonstrated again and again how a line infantry square of musket and bayonet answered the irregular cavalry of the East, and the pike had retired from the field of battle; the Highland battalions on the same line of development, however, still held pike and musket together on the line at Waterloo and in the Mississippi campaign that ended at New Orleans in 1815.
result: 打完的結果是一場以海軍勝利、陸軍失敗收場的戰爭。海上，英軍在達達尼爾斯方向強行通過、封鎖埃及沿岸、並在愛琴海追擊奧斯曼巡防艦，沒有任何一艘英國戰船被擊沉；英國完全掌控從直布羅陀到亞歷山大的地中海航路，把法國的東方通道壓到只剩紅海一線。陸上，英軍兩次遠征都靠海運解決補給，1808 年一度佔領開羅與三角洲，卻既沒有足夠兵力長駐埃及，也沒有能與英國國內財政相容的長期佔領成本；1809 年一月五日《達達尼爾斯條約》確認英國撤出埃及、奧斯曼恢復對埃及的名義統治，穆罕默德・阿里保留實權而不受追究。英國在紅海與漢志的探測則被暫時擱置，1810 年因奧斯曼收復紅海沿岸的英國據點而重新開戰，戰爭又拖到 1812 年前後才真正收場。回到卡面這件長槍：它在亞歷山大與布拉格兩場決定性戰鬥中都沒有上陣，勝方靠的是燧發火槍方陣、刺刀與衝鋒的龍騎，長矛在本役只以兩種殘餘形態存在——英軍高地團第三排用來頂住騎兵的守方長矛，以及馬穆魯克騎兵手裡那支在平原上被衝鋒撞散、隨主人退回沙漠的長騎槍。
resultEn: The outcome was a war won at sea and lost on land. At sea, the British forced the Dardanelles, blockaded the Egyptian coast and hunted the Ottoman frigates in the Aegean without losing a single British warship, and they held the whole Mediterranean road from Gibraltar to Alexandria, squeezing France's eastern outlet down to the Red Sea alone. On land, both British expeditions lived on sea transport, and in 1808 the British held Cairo and the Delta for a time, yet they had neither the troops to garrison Egypt nor a long occupation they could afford at home; the Treaty of the Dardanelles of 5 January 1809 confirmed the British withdrawal, restored nominal Ottoman rule over Egypt, and left Muhammad Ali in possession of his actual power untouched. The British probing in the Red Sea and the Hejaz was shelved, and when the Ottomans recovered the British posts on the Red Sea coast in 1810 the war began again, dragging on until around 1812. Back to the pike on this card: it never went into action in the two decisive battles at Alexandria and Boulak, and the winners relied on the flintlock musket square, the bayonet and the charge of the dragoons. Within this war the pike survived in only two residual forms, the defensive pike in the third rank of the Highland battalions, kept to hold off charging cavalry, and the long lance of the Mamluk horsemen, which was broken and scattered on the plain by a cavalry charge and then carried back into the desert by its riders.
